title: gtk: implement the freedesktop terminal intent
body:
Desktops are adopting the Terminal Intent spec (org.freedesktop.Terminal1) to run Terminal=true apps in the user's chosen terminal: GLib's GDesktopAppInfo calls LaunchCommand on the default terminal, and GNOME Settings will let users pick it. Ghostty is already D-Bus activatable, but did not export the interface or declare it in its desktop file, so it could not be chosen.

A command started this way on a freshly activated instance was also replaced by the user's initial-command, which affected +new-window -e too.

https://specifications.freedesktop.org/terminal-intent/latest/

AI disclosure: Claude Code assisted in the development of this PR.
